systems.ESCAT: Mateo J et al. 2018 Ann Oncol 29(9):1895-1902

disease_context_rule: AMP/ASCO/CAP Tier I requires evidence in the patient's own tumour type; identical evidence from a different tumour type is capped at Tier II. Free knowledge bases cover tumour types unevenly, so a variant can be genuinely Tier I under a guideline (e.g. NCCN) while the open evidence available here only supports Tier II.
disclaimer: Educational output. Tier assignment here is automated and does not replace expert review or a clinical molecular tumour board.
